name: What can go wrong with insurance-coordinated interior restoration?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with insurance-coordinated interior restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are under-documenting the damage, starting repairs too early, or choosing a contractor who does not coordinate well with the insurer. Those mistakes can lead to delays, change-order disputes, or out-of-pocket costs that could have been avoided with better claim support.
acceptedAnswer.description: The main risks are weak documentation, miscommunication with the insurer, and repairs starting before the claim scope is clear. Those issues can delay approval or create unexpected costs.
